ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XIX OF 2001
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance,
2000
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th
June, 2001]
No.S.LEGIS.1(19)/2001, dated 6-6-2001. The following Ordinance made
by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Sindh Local Government Elections (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2).It shall come into force at
once

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 10 of Sindh Ordinance No. X of 2000

ORDINANCE XIX OF 2001
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XIX OF 2001
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance,
2000
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th
June, 2001]
No.S.LEGIS.1(19)/2001, dated 6-6-2001. The following Ordinance made
by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 10 of Sindh Ordinance No. X of 2000.--In
the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000, in section 10, after
subsection (3) the following Explanation shall be added, namely:
"Explanation.--For
the purpose of this section; all members of the union councils notified as
returned candidates in the elections held under this Ordinance shall be deemed
to be members of the electoral college."
